title: Terry Lovelace and partner Toby never recovered

tellings.quote: gone Toby's gone he he uh Terry told me that he he literally he never fully recovered after their incident now he was not on duty they were simply on a camping trip

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who says he was abducted, tells Jesse Michels about a man named Terry Lovelace and his friend Toby. Woods says Lovelace told him that after an incident on a camping trip in 1977, when they were not on duty, he never fully recovered, and that Toby has since died. It is told to show the lasting toll such encounters can take.
